children: New Zealand's exports increased 15.4% yoy to NZD 6.66 billion in August 2026, after a downwardly revised 10.8% rise in the previous month.
Export growth was mainly driven by higher exports of milk powder, butter, and cheese (7.6%); meat and edible offal (23%); and precious metals, jewellery, and coins (53%).

title: New Zealand Exports Rise 15.4% in August
